---
title: "Build the labelled classifier dataset"
---

```{r}
source(here::here("R", "paths.R"))
source(here::here("R", "metadata.R"))
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(vroom)
library(readxl)

# Master TRUST4 table built by `workflow/run.sh master-trust4` (dataset/07_master_trust4.sh).
# This is the full table; every read below keeps only IGH rows, so it is equivalent to the
# IGH-only extract (`--chains IGH`). Column types are pinned so that type guessing on the first
# rows cannot mistype c_call or the T/F flags.
TRUST4_CSV <- data_path("sequences/master-trust4-dataset-sequence-unfiltered.csv")
TRUST4_COLS <- cols_only(sequence = "c", productive = "l", complete_vdj = "l", junction = "c",
                         consensus_count = "d", v_call = "c", c_call = "c", file_name = "c")
IGBLAST_THREADS <- as.integer(Sys.getenv("SLURM_CPUS_PER_TASK", "14"))

# Where the rebuilt files go. By default under BCRM_OUT/dataset/ (same relative paths), so a
# rebuild never overwrites the released files in BCRM_DATA; BCRM_REBUILD_DATA=1 writes them into
# BCRM_DATA, where the later stages read them. build_treatment_dataset.Rmd uses the same rule.
build_path <- function(rel) {
  p <- if (Sys.getenv("BCRM_REBUILD_DATA") == "1") data_path(rel) else out_path(file.path("dataset", rel))
  dir.create(dirname(p), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  p
}

# The sampling below is seeded, so a rebuild is reproducible. The released tables were drawn
# before seeding and so will not match a rebuild row for row; they remain the default inputs.
# Subjects with fewer than the sample size are unaffected.
SEED <- 8675309
```

```{r Read and filter OPIG metadata}

read_csv(data_path("metadata/allOPIGdefinedUnpairedMetadata.csv")) %>%
  filter(Vaccine == 'None') %>%
  filter(Disease %in% c('CMV','Dengue','EBV','HCV','HIV','Light-Chain-Amyloidosis','MuSK-MG','None','POEMS','SARS-COV-2','SLE','CLL','Ebola','AChR-MG')) %>%
  mutate(Disease = if_else(Disease == 'None', 'Healthy', Disease)) %>% #prevent pandas issues
  mutate(Year = as.numeric(str_extract(Author, "\\d{4}"))) %>%
  group_by(Disease) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(file_name, Author, Year, Age, BSource, BType, Disease, Subject, Isotype) -> df

```


```{r Add class weights and Bennett to full dataset, remove other category}
# Class weight is 1 for blood, 2 for CSF, and 3 for brain
# Multiplied by 1/v_identity * 2
# Add bennett data in, hold together for split
# Remove other category

read_csv(data_path("metadata/allOPIGdefinedUnpairedMetadata.csv")) %>%
  filter(Disease %in% c('CMV','Dengue','EBV','HCV','HIV','MuSK-MG','None','SARS-COV-2','SLE','Ebola','AChR-MG','MS')) %>%
  mutate(Disease = if_else(Disease %in% c('CMV','Dengue','EBV','HCV','HIV','SARS-COV-2','Ebola'), "Infectious Disease", Disease)) %>%
  mutate(Disease = if_else(Disease %in% c('MuSK-MG','SLE','AChR-MG'), "Autoimmune Disease", Disease)) %>%
  mutate(Disease = if_else(Disease %in% c('MS'), "Multiple sclerosis", Disease)) %>%
  mutate(Disease = if_else(Disease == 'None', 'Healthy', Disease)) %>% #prevent pandas issues
  mutate(Year = as.numeric(str_extract(Author, "\\d{4}"))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(file_name, Author, Year, Age, BSource, BType, Disease, Subject, Isotype) -> df

opig <-
  vroom(data_path("sequences/master-opig-dataset-sequence.csv")) %>%
  select(file_name, v_call, sequence, junction, consensus_count, productive, complete_vdj) %>%
  filter(productive == T) %>%
  filter(complete_vdj == T) %>%
  filter(str_starts(v_call, "IGH")) %>%
  right_join(df, by = 'file_name') %>%
  filter(!is.na(sequence), !is.na(Disease), !is.na(junction), !is.na(Author))

# Filter starting dataset
set.seed(SEED)
opig %>%
  group_by(Author, Subject) %>%
  slice_sample(n = 10000, replace = F) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Author, Year, Disease, Subject, Age, BSource, BType, Isotype, sequence, junction, consensus_count) %>%
  write_csv(build_path("sequences/all_high_quality_for_igblast.csv"), append = F)

####################
read_metadata() %>%
  select(Run, BioProject, create_date, Tissue, `Cell Type`, Age, Sex, DonorID, Disease, `Disease Class`, Treatment, `Patient State`, EDSS, `Years disease`) -> metadata

trust4 <-
  vroom(TRUST4_CSV, col_types = TRUST4_COLS) %>%
  filter(productive == T) %>%
  filter(complete_vdj == T) %>%
  filter(str_starts(v_call, "IGH")) %>%
  mutate(SRA = str_extract(file_name, "(SRR|ERR)[0-9]+")) %>%
  left_join(metadata, by = c('SRA' = 'Run')) %>%
  filter(!is.na(sequence), !is.na(Disease), !is.na(junction), !is.na(BioProject))

# Filter starting dataset
set.seed(SEED)
trust4 %>%
  mutate(Year = year(create_date)) %>%
  mutate(Disease = if_else(Disease %in% c('Healthy','Control'), 'Healthy', Disease)) %>%
  mutate(Disease = if_else(Disease %in% c('Sepsis','Viral encephalitis'), "Infectious Disease", Disease)) %>%
  mutate(Disease = if_else(Disease %in% c('Type 1 Diabetes','Uveitis','Autoimmune encephalitis','Behcet\'s disease','NMO','Neurosarcoidosis'), "Autoimmune Disease", Disease)) %>%
  filter(!Disease %in% c('Idiopathic intracranial hyertension','ALS')) %>% #drop old other category, only a handful of sequences
  dplyr::rename(Author = BioProject) %>%
  dplyr::rename(BSource = Tissue) %>%
  dplyr::rename(BType = `Cell Type`) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Isotype = c_call) %>%
  mutate(Subject = paste(Age, Sex, DonorID)) %>%
  mutate(Disease = if_else(str_detect(Subject, "Twin(?:1|2|3|4)\\.2"), "Multiple sclerosis", Disease)) %>% # recode MS twins to MS
  mutate(Disease = if_else(str_detect(Subject, "SCNI"), "Multiple sclerosis", Disease)) %>% # recode MS twins to MS
  group_by(Author, Subject, BSource, BType) %>%
  slice_sample(n = 10000, replace = F) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Author, Year, Disease, Subject, Age, BSource, BType, Isotype, sequence, junction, consensus_count) %>%
  write_csv(build_path("sequences/all_high_quality_for_igblast.csv"), append = T)

####### Add Bennett data ####
read_metadata() %>%
  select(Run, BioProject, create_date, Tissue, `Cell Type`, Age, Sex, DonorID, Disease, `Disease Class`, Treatment, `Patient State`, EDSS, `Years disease`, Filename) %>%
  filter(str_starts(BioProject, 'Bennett')) -> metadata

trust4 <-
  vroom(TRUST4_CSV, col_types = TRUST4_COLS) %>%
  filter(str_starts(v_call, "IGH")) %>%
  filter(complete_vdj == TRUE) %>%
  filter(productive == TRUE) %>%
  left_join(metadata, by = c('file_name' = 'Filename')) %>%
  filter(str_starts(BioProject, 'Bennett')) %>%
  filter(!is.na(sequence), !is.na(junction))

set.seed(SEED)
trust4 %>%
  mutate(Year = year(create_date)) %>%
  mutate(Disease = if_else(Disease %in% c('Healthy','Control'), 'Healthy', Disease)) %>%
   mutate(Disease = if_else(Disease %in% c('Type 1 Diabetes','Uveitis','Autoimmune encephalitis','Behcet\'s disease','NMO'), "Autoimmune Disease", Disease)) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Author = BioProject) %>%
  dplyr::rename(BSource = Tissue) %>%
  dplyr::rename(BType = `Cell Type`) %>%
  dplyr::rename(Isotype = c_call) %>%
  mutate(Subject = paste(Age, Sex, DonorID)) %>%
  group_by(Author, Subject, BSource, BType) %>%
  slice_sample(n = 10000, replace = F) %>%
  select(Author, Year, Disease, Subject, Age, BSource, BType, Isotype, sequence, junction, consensus_count) %>%
  write_csv(build_path("sequences/all_high_quality_for_igblast.csv"), append = T)

##### Re-annotate all with igblastn #########
hq <- read_csv(build_path("sequences/all_high_quality_for_igblast.csv"))

# summary of how many were sampled per disease
hq %>%
  group_by(Disease) %>%
  summarize(count = n())

library(igblastr)
#install_IMGT_germline_db('202531-1', force = T)
use_germline_db("IMGT-202531-1.Homo_sapiens.IGH+IGK+IGL")
use_c_region_db("_IMGT.human.IGH+IGK+IGL.202412")

seqs <- DNAStringSet(hq$sequence)
names(seqs) <- rep(1, nrow(hq))

# Run igblastn
igblast_results <- 
  igblastn(
  query = seqs,
  organism = "human",
  outfmt = "AIRR",
  num_threads=IGBLAST_THREADS,
  num_alignments_V=1,
  num_alignments_C=1
)

##### clip v start through j end sequence #######
hq %>%
  select(Author, Year, Disease, Subject, Age, BSource, BType, consensus_count) %>%
  bind_cols(igblast_results) %>%
  filter(productive == T) %>%
  filter(complete_vdj == T) %>%
  filter(str_starts(v_call, "IGH")) %>%
  mutate(sequence = str_sub(sequence, v_sequence_start, j_sequence_end)) %>%
  filter(str_count(sequence, 'N') < 1) %>%
  select(Author, Year, Disease, Subject, Age, BSource, BType, v_call, c_call, sequence, junction, consensus_count, v_identity) -> catch

write_csv(catch, build_path("sequences/all_hq_igblast_realigned.csv"))
catch <- read_csv(build_path("sequences/all_hq_igblast_realigned.csv"))

catch %>%
  filter(Author != 'PRJNA248475') %>%
  filter(Author != 'PRJNA248411') %>%
  mutate(BSource = if_else(BSource %in% c('Brain', 'Brain-Lesion', 'Cortex', 'Choroid-Plexus', 'Pia-Mater'), 'Brain', BSource)) %>%
  mutate(BSource = if_else(BSource %in% c('Cerebrospinal-Fluid'), 'CSF', BSource)) %>%
  mutate(weight = 1 * (BSource == 'CSF') + 3 * (BSource == 'Brain') + 1) -> catch #+ (100 / v_identity)

# Seeded before the split, so the split does not depend on the sampling above
set.seed(SEED)
splits <-
  catch %>%
  group_initial_split(group = Author, prop = 0.5)

training(splits) %>%
  group_by(Disease, str_starts(Author, 'PRJ')) %>%
  summarize(seqs = n(),
            patients = length(unique(Subject)))

testing(splits) %>%
  group_by(Disease, str_starts(Author, 'PRJ')) %>%
  summarize(seqs = n(),
            patients = length(unique(Subject)))

write_csv(training(splits), build_path("classifier/classifier_data_igblast-train-weights.csv"), append = F)
write_csv(testing(splits), build_path("classifier/classifier_data_igblast-test-weights.csv"), append = F)
```

```{r filtering for ballerini}

trust4 <- 
  vroom(data_path("sequences/master-trust4-dataset-sequence-unfiltered.csv"))

sra_meta_sum <- read_metadata() %>%
  select(Run, BioProject, create_date, Tissue, Age, Sex, DonorID, Disease)

# Step 1: classify chain type and aggregate per (SRA, chain_type) — no join yet
trust4_sra <- 
  trust4 %>%
  mutate(
    SRA = str_extract(file_name, "(SRR|ERR)[0-9]+"),
    chain_type = case_when(
      str_starts(v_call, "IGHV") ~ coalesce(c_call, "IGH_unknown"),
      str_starts(v_call, "IGKV") ~ "IGK",
      str_starts(v_call, "IGLV") ~ "IGL",
      str_starts(v_call, "TR")   ~ "TCR",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(SRA), !is.na(chain_type)) %>%
  filter(!str_starts(v_call, "TR")) %>%
  group_by(SRA) %>% #, chain_type
  summarise(n_seqs = n(), .groups = "drop")

# Step 2: join the small (SRA × chain_type) table to metadata — fast
trust4_pre_meta <- trust4_sra %>%
  left_join(sra_meta_sum, by = c("SRA" = "Run")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Disease), !is.na(BioProject)) %>%
  mutate(tissue_group = case_when(
    Tissue %in% c('Brain', 'Brain-Lesion', 'Cortex', 'Choroid-Plexus', 'Pia-Mater') ~ 'Brain',
    Tissue %in% c('Cerebrospinal-Fluid', 'CSF')  ~ 'CSF',
    Tissue %in% c('Blood', 'PBMC')                ~ 'Blood',
    TRUE ~ 'Other'
  ))

trust4_pre_meta %>%
  group_by(BioProject, Age, Sex, DonorID, Disease) %>%
  mutate(uid = paste0(sample(letters, 9, replace = T), collapse="")) %>%
  group_by(BioProject) %>%
  summarize(total_seqs = sum(n_seqs),
            median_seqs = median(n_seqs),
            subjects = length(unique(uid))) %>%
  filter(median_seqs > 10) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_seqs)) -> summary
  
  
write_csv(summary, out_path("dataset/quick-summary-stats.csv"))
```

```{r Check possible duplicate study}
train <- read_csv(build_path("classifier/classifier_data_igblast-train-weights.csv"))
test <- read_csv(build_path("classifier/classifier_data_igblast-test-weights.csv"))

train %>%
  filter(Author == 'PRJNA866296')

train %>%
  filter(Author == 'PRJNA684320') #both problem ds in train, will drop 'PRJNA866296' since it is smaller

train %>%
  filter(str_count(Author, 'Galson') > 0) %>%
  group_by(Author) %>%
  count()

test %>%
  filter(str_count(Author, 'Galston') > 0) %>%
  group_by(Author) %>%
  count() #phew, this was a stupid one opig oas but it is only in the train set, fixed for cv at patient classification time


train %>%
  filter(str_count(Author, 'Zhou') > 0) %>%
  group_by(Author) %>%
  count()

test %>%
  filter(str_count(Author, 'Zhou') > 0) %>%
  group_by(Author) %>%
  count() #possible resampling of same patients, will group in patient cv classification

train %>%
  filter(str_count(Author, 'Zhu') > 0) %>%
  group_by(Author) %>%
  count()

test %>%
  filter(str_count(Author, 'Zhu') > 0) %>%
  group_by(Author) %>%
  count() #god bless

train %>%
  filter(str_count(Author, 'Soto') > 0) %>%
  group_by(Author) %>%
  count()

test %>%
  filter(str_count(Author, 'Soto') > 0) %>%
  group_by(Author) %>%
  count() #same fold but from paper these are different patients
```
